Terrorist Threat or Harmless Phrase?

NSA Game

2013
Web-based game, social media integration

Terrorist Threat or Harmless Phrase? pairs a real Department of Homeland Security surveillance keyword with a plausible-sounding decoy and asks the player which one is on the government’s watch list. Players’ answers feed back into the game, so the decoys grow harder to tell from the real terms as the rounds go on. Guess wrong, and a Google search for the flagged term opens in the player’s browser, implicating them in the very monitoring the game is about. The keywords come from the DHS “Analyst’s Desktop Binder,” released under a Freedom of Information Act request, the same list behind NSA Haiku Generator.
